Correct: B. Even d Rotary Width, Frequencies ω_i=base^(−2i/d), Angles pω_i. Interleaved Q/K Pairs Rotate Sin/Cos. Original Complete Runnable PyTorch Code Below Unchanged; Common Position Shift Q–K Dot Products Float Toleranceలో Same అని Check. Production Heads, Batches, Partial RoPE, KV Cacheకి Broadcasting Care Needed.
import torch

def rope(x, positions, base=10000.0):
    d = x.shape[-1]
    assert d % 2 == 0
    freq = base ** (-torch.arange(0, d, 2, device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype) / d)
    angles = positions.to(x.dtype)[:, None] * freq[None, :]
    even, odd = x[..., 0::2], x[..., 1::2]
    rotated = torch.stack((
        even * angles.cos() - odd * angles.sin(),
        even * angles.sin() + odd * angles.cos()
    ), dim=-1)
    return rotated.flatten(-2)

Q = torch.tensor([[1., 0., .5, .2], [.2, .7, .4, .8]])
K = torch.tensor([[.5, .6, .7, .1], [.2, .9, .4, .4]])
positions = torch.arange(2)
scores = rope(Q, positions) @ rope(K, positions).T
shifted = rope(Q, positions + 5) @ rope(K, positions + 5).T
torch.testing.assert_close(scores, shifted)
print(scores)
